law_name: Law on Personal Data Protection (PDP Law)
jurisdiction: Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection
applies_to: Public & private controllers and processors (incl. foreign firms targeting Serbia)
key_requirements: Lawful basis & consent, data subject rights, breach notification, DPO appointment
retention_period: No longer than necessary for the purpose
enforcement_authority: Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection (Poverenik)
penalties_range: Up to RSD 2M fine for legal entities
deceased_data: No explicit rule found; law protects natural persons and data subject is a natural person (arts. 2, 4), suggesting living persons only (unconfirmed)
notes: Replaced 2008 law; draft replacement law in consultation to 10 Sep 2026 (not enacted)
